##### Project general facts

Bab Al Qasr Residence 31 is a majestic residential project that embodies the essence of luxury and warm Arabian hospitality, mirroring the legendary elegance of the renowned Bab Al Qasr Hotel. This extraordinary development boasts fully furnished serviced apartments that exude sophistication, featuring spacious layouts, high-end finishes, and breathtaking views of Yas Bay that mesmerize the senses. Each residence has been meticulously crafted to provide an unparalleled lifestyle, where premium materials, superior craftsmanship, and meticulous attention to detail converge to create a living experience that sets a new benchmark for exclusive urban living.

Beyond the exquisite residences, Bab Al Qasr Residence 31 offers an extraordinary array of resort-style amenities that elevate daily living to new heights of indulgence and wellbeing. Residents enjoy a magnificent garden-level swimming pool, a serene roof garden with an infinity pool, a fully equipped health club, and dedicated kids' pool and splash park. The development also features elegant lounges across multiple levels, while an impressive pay-as-you-go menu of services ensures that every need is anticipated and every desire is fulfilled with effortless ease, courtesy of valet parking, housekeeping, in-residence dining, childcare, and transportation.

The residences at Bab Al Qasr Residence 31 are a testament to refined elegance, featuring superior finishing quality throughout, fully furnished interiors elegantly appointed with high-end furniture from The One, and semi-closed kitchens equipped with top-brand built-in appliances from Siemens. Every unit boasts additional spaces, including laundry, storage, and maid's rooms, while ground-floor units and sky villas are graced with private gardens, offering exclusive outdoor sanctuaries. The interiors showcase premium materials, including marble flooring, decorative lighting, and custom cabinetry, all tailored to create a luxurious atmosphere where beauty and comfort exist in perfect harmony.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Island is the epitome of entertainment and luxury in Abu Dhabi, a vibrant destination that offers an extraordinary lifestyle amidst world-class attractions, pristine beaches, and top-tier shopping and dining experiences. This dynamic island is home to a multitude of world-class attractions, from thrilling theme parks to sophisticated leisure venues, ensuring that adventure and excitement are always within reach. The perfect blend of leisure and excitement defines this exceptional location, where the air is alive with endless possibilities and every moment is a testament to the island's irrepressible energy.

Life within Yas Island is defined by its unparalleled convenience and vibrant spirit, with the iconic Yas Bay waterfront serving as a stunning backdrop to daily life. The neighbourhood offers effortless access to Abu Dhabi's finest cultural, business, and leisure destinations, while the surrounding area provides a wealth of recreational opportunities and world-class amenities. Every day brings new discoveries, and every moment is enriched by the dynamic pulse of one of the region's most exciting destinations, where the beauty of the surroundings and the thrill of the attractions converge to create an unforgettable experience.

The surroundings of Yas Island offer a treasure trove of attractions and experiences, from pristine beaches and luxurious resorts to cutting-edge entertainment venues and cultural landmarks. The island's strategic location ensures seamless connectivity to the heart of Abu Dhabi and beyond, making it an ideal choice for those who value both excitement and convenience. Yas Island truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the vibrant energy of a world-class entertainment destination with the serenity of a luxurious waterfront community, where every aspect of life is elevated to new heights of luxury and sophistication.
